posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
I managed to port Battlefield 1942 to mobile web too

So now it's playable as full multiplayer on iPhone and Android from their browser! 🤯

Claude Code built its own graphic layer that translates Direct3D (DirectX) instructions to WebGL, sitting between the game's machine code https://t.co/pljy7JZz74 https://t.co/cKixtHaAlP
posts.text_zh:
我把 Battlefield 1942 也移植到手机网页上了

现在在 iPhone 和 Android 上直接用浏览器就能玩完整的多人联机！🤯

Claude Code 自己写了一层图形层，把 Direct3D（DirectX）指令翻译成 WebGL，夹在游戏机器码和浏览器之间，所以分辨率可以随便改！

唯一的问题是有些东西会被切掉（比如下面的手臂或载具内部），毕竟这游戏本来就不是为竖屏设计的！

好了，我刚把 bf1942.pieter.com 上 Battlefield 1942 的游戏和服务器从 v1.0（试玩版）升级到了 v1.61（最新版）

这又经历了一轮反编译和大量新的 bug 修复，才让它能在网页上多人联机

不过现在能跑了，游戏也好玩多了，v1.61 是 2004 年发布的，比最初的 v1.0 晚两年

玩法疯狂又激烈，这基本就是所有现代 Battlefield 和 Call of Duty 游戏的鼻祖

posts.author: gregisenberg
posts.text:
One of the most important questions of our time:

"If AI can build almost anything, what should I build?"

It's the question behind most of the anxiety I hear about AI right now

I broke down the 8 kinds of businesses I think get stronger as AI gets better https://t.co/cqr718RHur
posts.text_zh:
这个时代最重要的问题之一：

“如果 AI 几乎什么都能做出来，那我该做什么？”

这是我现在听到的大多数 AI 焦虑背后的问题

我拆解了我认为会随着 AI 变强而变得更强的 8 类生意

posts.author: steipete
posts.text: Do individual limits still make sense? As capabilities increase you want to work with and support an agent that represents your project, that runs loops and evolves your codebase. The humans merely curate the automations. https://t.co/7A1dRKVtJk
posts.text_zh: 个人额度限制还有意义吗？随着能力提升，你会希望和一个代表你项目的 agent 协作并支持它，让它跑循环、持续演进你的代码库。人类只是负责策划这些自动化。（引用的是 Apple 削减员工 AI 支出预算的新闻：工程师每日额度从 $300 降到 $200，计划进一步降到 $100）
posts.quoted_text: NEW: Apple is cutting employee AI spending budgets even as it pushes workers to use the technology more. Engineers have seen daily limits cut from $300 to $200, with further reductions to $100 planned. Other teams could see limits fall to $25. https://t.co/4tnOIaxpDz
